lead.title: Primedea, a Zurich teleradiology network founded in 2026, closes a pre-seed round led by Hansi Hansmann, promising emergency reports in under 30 minutes
lead.deck: Founded this year by radiologist Florian Huber, Samuel Frey and Christopher Zemina, with an office in Vienna, the startup routes studies within minutes to one of its 20-plus freelance radiologists through direct integration with clients' RIS, around the clock, billed per report with no minimum volume; one Zurich institute already sends it about 100 MRI and CT reports a week. The round, led by Austrian business angel Hansi Hansmann (amount undisclosed), funds the expansion of the network and platform: a software bet on the radiologist shortage, where value lies in orchestrating the workflow rather than in the image itself.

milestone.title: France's digital health agency ANS opens a consultation, until December 4, on the framework that will make practice-management software data portable
milestone.summary: Stemming from Article 55 of the simplification law and drafted by a working group of the Conseil du numérique en santé, the security, interoperability and ethics framework requires free export of a "pivot scope" of data, in a common format with shared security and documentation rules, delivered within 30 days at most. It will become binding by ministerial order, alongside an implementation guide and a decree; five vendors have already committed to meeting the obligations early.
milestone.why: Switching practice software without losing patients' records has long locked the market in favour of incumbent vendors. By removing that exit cost, portability opens a window for new entrants (AI-native, cloud-based software) just as the second wave of France's Ségur programme pushes practitioners to rethink their tools.

brefsEurope.title: Atos, leading a consortium with Accenture, takes over management of France's shared medical record (DMP) for the Cnam and merges it into Mon espace santé
brefsEurope.summary: The consortium says it migrated the DMP into the Mon espace santé architecture with no service interruption, hosted in its French data centers, and has had its Mon espace santé mandate renewed: nearly 28 million activated accounts and more than 40 million documents uploaded each month, according to Atos. A single national backbone that software vendors will now have to plug into.

brefsEurope.title: HealthMate, backed by Miguel Hernández University's science park, wins €325,000 from Spain's CDTI (NEOTEC 2026) for voice agents that read the patient's tone
brefsEurope.summary: PHYSIA-VOICE will analyse voice tone and rhythm, combined with conversation context and clinical data, to adapt real-world calls; the company already claims an AI assistant for scheduling, records and billing used in 327 centres by more than 3,100 professionals and for 563,000 patients.

brefsEurope.title: Spain's Tucuvi is the only European company singled out in CB Insights' Digital Health 50, with its Class IIb-certified voice agent LOLA
brefsEurope.summary: The ranking, drawn from more than 50,000 companies, highlights LOLA, a phone follow-up agent described as Europe's first voice AI certified as a Class IIb medical device and deployed in more than 10% of Spain's public hospitals; 26 of the 50 winners target administrative burden.

brefsEurope.title: East Lancashire Hospitals moves its neonatal ICU to electronic prescribing and co-leads a shared EPR with three neighbouring trusts
brefsEurope.summary: The NICU ePMA relies on 220 prescribing bundles developed and tested over two years; ambient voice technology already drafts notes and letters, and the trust co-leads a shared EPR with Blackpool, Lancashire Teaching and Morecambe Bay across Lancashire and South Cumbria.

brefsEurope.title: Devon's mental health trust launches an ambient voice procurement to onboard about 200 users a month over 11 months
brefsEurope.summary: Funded with £159,000 in capital and £300,000 in revenue over three years, rollout will start in early FY2027/28 under conditions (EPR integration, clinical and cyber safety, benefit measurement); the current pilot is extended, while Wales has just abandoned its own £10M AVT procurement for lack of compliant suppliers.

brefsEurope.title: DRIMbox: French facilities have until January 12, 2027 to secure Ségur funding for their imaging-sharing gateway
brefsEurope.summary: The funding request must be filed by the supplier before noon that day; PACS vendor MEDIN +, whose DRIMbox'IN has been listed as Ségur wave 2 compliant since July 6, 2026, claims 250 sites and more than 100,000 patients a month. A deadline that concentrates shared-imaging purchasing decisions into the next eight weeks.

brefsIntl.title: Aevius, a Mass General Brigham spin-out founded by the team behind Modella AI (acquired by AstraZeneca), raises $22M led by Insight Partners
brefsIntl.summary: Its multimodal models, trained on EHR data, notes, pathology, imaging and genomics, build a continuously updated patient representation to forecast outcomes, find similar patients and identify trial cohorts; Eric Topol chairs its scientific advisory board.

brefsIntl.title: Knit Health raises a $35M Series A led by NEA and unveils Med-BEAM, a "world model" that learns from clinical decisions rather than text
brefsIntl.summary: A UC Berkeley spin-out founded in 2025 ($46.6M raised in total, with Town Hall Ventures and SignalFire), it models each patient's trajectory from sequences of orders, referrals and diagnoses and claims, on its own benchmarks, up to 4x the accuracy of a frontier LLM at 24 hours.

brefsIntl.title: The US finalises its HIPAA overhaul: patient record access within 15 days and free transfer to the health app of their choice
brefsIntl.summary: The rule, published in the Federal Register on November 19, cuts the access deadline from 30 to 15 days, makes electronic copies sent via a personal app free, and clarifies that such app developers are not business associates: a tailwind for consumer apps that aggregate medical records.

word.definition: The interpretation of imaging studies (CT, MRI, X-ray) by a radiologist located somewhere other than where the images were acquired, thanks to their secure transmission.

parts.label: Transmitting site
parts.role: the hospital or practice that performs the scan and sends images and patient data

parts.label: Routing platform
parts.role: integrates with the client's RIS/PACS and assigns each study to the right radiologist

parts.label: Receiving site
parts.role: the teleradiologist who reads the images and writes the report

how.t: Images leave the acquisition site via VPN, DICOM push with HL7 messaging, or secure web services (IHE XDS/XDR profiles).
The platform assigns the study to an available, qualified radiologist; Primedea says it routes studies within minutes through direct RIS integration.
The teleradiologist delivers a preliminary read (on call), a final report or a second opinion, which flows back into the transmitting site's record.

word.why: The radiologist shortage and steadily rising imaging volumes make remote reading a structural answer, especially for night and weekend cover. For investors, value is shifting from the doctor network itself to orchestration software (routing, RIS/PACS integration, quality control) and AI triage, under a strong constraint: the European Society of Radiology treats teleradiology as a medical act subject to the same quality requirements as on-site reading.

startups.name: Primedea
startups.use: Network of 20-plus freelance radiologists connected to clients' RIS, emergency reports in under 30 minutes 24/7; pre-seed led by Hansi Hansmann in November 2026

startups.name: Hexarad
startups.use: Teleradiology firm founded in 2016 by NHS consultant radiologists, with its own software suite (RIS, Hexarad Edge integration engine, Hub for urgent reporting); €13M Series B led by MTIP

startups.name: HLH Group
startups.use: UK firm providing remote subspecialist radiology reporting (lung, heart, prostate), describing itself as the leading independent reporting provider for the NHS Lung Cancer Screening programme, with cloud-hosted PACS/RIS and AI integrations
